# rapttor/yii2-themes

> Yii2 package: per-user themes chosen by id (complete six-colour sets with light, dark or soft/neumorphic style), a picker widget, CSS-variable output, and a builder that turns image colours into contrast-safe themes. MIT.

Integrating or changing this package: read AGENTS.md first.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): integration steps, invariants (stable ids, contrast tests, CSS variables), how to add themes
- [README.md](README.md): theme list, install, configuration, soft theme tokens
- [src/Themes.php](src/Themes.php): the application component (all(), normalize(), resolved(), css(), htmlAttributes(), registerHead(), rules())
- [src/Palettes.php](src/Palettes.php): built-in themes (data)
- [src/Backgrounds.php](src/Backgrounds.php): page backgrounds (static, gradient, solid, animated, Unsplash photo), overlay, palette per background; see README section Backgrounds
- [src/ThemeBuilder.php](src/ThemeBuilder.php): image colours to a readable theme
- [tests/ThemesTest.php](tests/ThemesTest.php): the contrast rules every theme must pass
